meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动读取项目中的规则文件（如 CONTEXT.md），在对话开始或你提交消息时注入静态项目指令，并在修改代码后注入匹配的文件级规则。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的行为、项目规则、支持的文件位置或环境配置时触发。

say.note: Claude 会列出当前项目已注入的规则。

say.text: 帮我检查一下规则文件是否生效。
say.note: Claude 会验证规则文件是否被正确加载。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude automatically reads project rule files (e.g., CONTEXT.md), injects static project instructions on session start or user prompt submit, and injects matching file-specific rules after code modification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, project rules, supported rule file locations, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: What rules does this project have?
say_en.note: Claude lists the injected rules for the current project.

say_en.text: Check if the rule files are active.
say_en.note: Claude verifies that rule files are loaded correctly.
